source_name: European Court of Human Rights / HUDOC
collections: Decisions: Grand Chamber, Chamber, Committee, Commission, Screening Panel
Advisory Opinions: Article 47 and Protocol No. 16
Committee of Ministers Resolutions: execution and merits
default_collection_note: HUDOC selects Grand Chamber and Chamber judgments by default. Other collections must be explicitly selected.
non_official_translation_rule: Non-official translations may be available for information. Unless otherwise indicated, they are not produced by the Registry and are not checked by the Registry for accuracy or linguistic quality.

text_search.purpose: word, sentence or sequence search inside selected document collections

importance_levels.1: High importance: significant contribution to development, clarification or modification of case-law.
importance_levels.2: Medium importance: goes beyond merely applying existing case-law.
importance_levels.3: Low importance: generally applies existing case-law, friendly settlements or strike-outs unless a point of interest arises.
importance_levels.key_case: Most important cases selected by the Bureau, following recommendation by the Jurisconsult.

analysis_coverage_rule: Only Key cases and importance levels 1 and 2 contain full analysis searchable under all search fields. Level 3 has limited analytical metadata from 2007 onwards.

boolean_defaults.note: Most filters other than Language, Importance and Date allow AND/OR within the same filter.

retrieval_policy: Bind every legal proposition to the actual HUDOC judgment/decision or official case document whenever available.
Treat Case Details as structured metadata, not a substitute for the reasoning text.
Use non-official translations as research aids only and preserve the authoritative-language link.
Use importance level to rank jurisprudential significance, never as a claim of greater formal binding force.
Do not infer absence of an issue from missing Level-3 analytical fields.
Press releases, country profiles and media pages are context-only.

snapshot_2026_10_11.displayed_scope_note: The supplied HUDOC snapshot showed the default judgment collection selection, not a count of every HUDOC document collection.
